consequences.text: Cuebiq's business has been run since 2023 by Cuebiq Group, LLC. According to Cuebiq Group's own filing, as the court summarized it, Cuebiq, Inc. defaulted on a loan and its lender foreclosed. The filing says Espresso Special Acquisition LLC, since renamed Cuebiq Group, then bought the business at a private foreclosure sale.
consequences.wording: According to Cuebiq Group's own filing, as summarized by the court (US District Court for the Southern District of New York, 2025-08-21).

sources.title: Cuebiq Group, LLC v. PaeDae, Inc. (S.D.N.Y. No. 24-CV-7542, transferred to S.D. Cal. as No. 3:25-cv-02255), opinion and order

consequences.text: In 2021 The Markup reported that Cuebiq received raw, precise location data from the family-tracking app Life360, and that the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention had a contract with Cuebiq for aggregated location data. Life360 said in 2022 it would stop selling precise data to most buyers.
